versions.subject: multiple dll sideloading rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith:
        - '\edputil.dll'
filter_main_legit_path:
    Image:
        - 'C:\Program Files\windows NT\Accessories\wordpad.exe'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows NT\Accessories\wordpad.exe'
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
        - 'C\Windows\WinSxS\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*\\edputil.dll" NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Program Files\\windows NT\\Accessories\\wordpad.exe", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Windows NT\\Accessories\\wordpad.exe") ImageLoaded IN ("C:\\Windows\\System32\\*", "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*", "C\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*"))
